questions.explanation: I. There are n multiples of 5 among 5n tickets. Answer: 1/5. II. Black balls make up 3n of the 4n total. Answer: 3/4. III. Exactly half the integers from 1 through an even endpoint are even. Answer: 1/2.

questions.question:
Solve these three tasks. Which option lists the answers in order?
I. A bag has 10 red, 10 blue and 20 green balls. Find P(red or blue).
II. Of 100 equally likely tickets, 30 win a prize. Find P(not winning).
III. A box has 16 green and 24 yellow counters. Find P(not green).
questions.explanation: I. Red and blue together give 2n of the 4n balls. Answer: 1/2. II. The remaining 7n tickets out of 10n do not win. Answer: 7/10. III. The complement of green consists of 3n yellow counters out of 5n. Answer: 3/5.

questions.question:
Solve these three tasks. Which option lists the answers in order?
I. A number is chosen uniformly from 1 to 60. Find P(divisible by 3).
II. A bag contains 8 red and 24 blue balls. Find P(red).
III. One ticket is chosen from 40 equally likely tickets numbered from 1. Find P(a multiple of 5).
questions.explanation: I. There are 2n multiples of 3 among 6n integers. Answer: 1/3. II. There are n red balls out of 4n total. Answer: 1/4. III. There are n multiples of 5 among 5n tickets. Answer: 1/5.

questions.question:
Solve these three tasks. Which option lists the answers in order?
I. An event has probability 10/11. Find the probability of its complement.
II. Choose one integer uniformly from 1 to 32. Find P(even).
III. A bag has 8 red, 8 blue and 16 green balls. Find P(red or blue).
questions.explanation: I. Use 1−10/11=1/11. Answer: 1/11. II. Exactly half the integers from 1 through an even endpoint are even. Answer: 1/2. III. Red and blue together give 2n of the 4n balls. Answer: 1/2.
